tools.Name: Crawl4AI
tools.Description: An open-source, LLM-friendly web crawler and scraper that converts web content into structured Markdown.
tools.Use_Case: Preparing web data for RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), building AI agents, and creating data pipelines.

tools.Name: MarkItDown
tools.Description: A lightweight Python utility by Microsoft for converting various files (PDF, PPT, Word, Excel, etc.) to Markdown.
tools.Use_Case: Converting complex office documents and multimedia into a text-based format suitable for LLM analysis.

tools.Name: MoneyPrinterTurbo
tools.Description: A tool that generates high-quality short videos automatically using AI LLMs.
tools.Use_Case: Automated creation of short-form video content from themes or keywords, including script, assets, and subtitles.
